claude.name: /butler:prd
claude.description: 把权威 PRD 拆进项目知识库，并随改版保持同步——首次拆分 / 改版对齐 / 只读看板

codex.name: $butler-prd
codex.description: Run Butler's PRD-first workflow for a supplied product document, PRD update, or PRD status request. Use when the user gives a PRD or asks to split, import, update, reconcile, or inspect versioned PRD references.
codex.short_description: Split, update, or inspect versioned PRDs
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-prd to process this product requirements document.

claude.name: /butler:review
claude.description: 给当前迭代的改动做代码 / 产物复核——默认当前上下文快速自检，或另起干净上下文做更狠的独立复核

codex.name: $butler-review
codex.description: Review code, documents, plans, or current changes with Butler's review protocol. Use for quick self-review, acceptance-criteria verification, full review, or an explicitly requested independent review.
codex.short_description: Run the Butler review workflow safely
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-review to review the current changes against Butler criteria.

claude.name: /butler:milestone
claude.description: 开一个里程碑（大版本范围单元，聚合多个迭代），或只读看板看当前里程碑进度——留空/贴一段方向说明=录入开题，status=只读看板

codex.name: $butler-milestone
codex.description: Create or inspect a Butler milestone from a product brief, roadmap, or large requirement. Use when the user asks to open, plan, split, route, or show status for a multi-iteration milestone.
codex.short_description: Run the Butler milestone workflow safely
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-milestone to turn this brief into a milestone roadmap.

claude.name: /butler:upgrade
claude.description: 安全升级已部署 Butler 项目——先由仓库升级器 dry-run，再经显式决定事务 apply；不解析 Markdown 散文写项目

codex.name: $butler-upgrade
codex.description: Upgrade or inspect an existing Butler-enabled project through Butler's deterministic migration executor. Use when the user asks to update, migrate, restamp, or check the Butler version gap.
codex.short_description: Run the Butler upgrade workflow safely
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-upgrade to upgrade this deployed Butler project safely.

claude.name: /butler:ideation
claude.description: 需求还没想清时的脑暴——把模糊意图逼成可执行的验收清单：意图探测 → 隐性需求展开 → 多维压力测试 → 收敛 AC

codex.name: $butler-ideation
codex.description: Explore and refine an unclear product or engineering idea with Butler without entering the execution lifecycle. Use for brainstorming, requirement discovery, trade-off analysis, MVP reduction, or shaping a vague request before implementation.
codex.short_description: Run the Butler ideation workflow safely
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-ideation to refine this idea before execution.

claude.name: /butler:preference
claude.description: 偏好探针开关——留空看当前状态；on/off 隐私总开关；reback on/off 开关反哺；distill 手动蒸馏（实验性，数据存 butler 仓库之外）

codex.name: $butler-preference
codex.description: Inspect or change Butler's preference-learning controls. Use when the user asks about preference consent, collection, reback, distillation, project suppression, or the status of Butler preference learning.
codex.short_description: Run the Butler preference workflow safely
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-preference to inspect Butler preference-learning status.

claude.name: /butler:loop
claude.description: ⚠️ 收敛闭环死磕——把 P4 执行升到高强度「执行→探测→反思→修正」死磕到验证全绿或定量熔断（高强度·长时·消耗大，郑重触发）

codex.name: $butler-loop
codex.description: Explicitly run Butler's high-intensity convergence loop for a current P4 implementation. Invoke only when the user names $butler-loop or explicitly asks for Butler's convergence loop; never infer this high-cost mode from a routine request.
codex.short_description: Run the convergence loop only when invoked
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-loop to run the explicit high-intensity convergence loop.

claude.name: /butler:dangerous
claude.description: ⚠️ 无人值守长程自治（实验性）——留空开启（模型自审替 ACK、自动拆迭代跑完整生命周期）；off 关闭；status 只看状态。风险显著高于标准，建议只在可隔离/可回滚环境开

codex.name: $butler-dangerous
codex.description: Explicitly control Butler's experimental unattended autonomy mode. Invoke only when the user names $butler-dangerous or clearly requests Butler dangerous mode; never infer autonomous authority from an ordinary request.
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-dangerous to inspect or explicitly control dangerous mode.
